description: The thresholds and reasons of the phone's Signal rules for the Attention flag (spec #5, issue #26). Thresholds are starting values. core's DailyThresholds and FlagReasons (SignalRulesFixtureTest) and the seed's THRESHOLDS and REASONS (firebase/seed/test/unit/flags.test.js) are checked against this file: change it, core and the seed together.

reasons.sleepFarBelowUsual: Slept far less than usual last night.
reasons.inactive: No steps and no screen use in the last 24 hours.
reasons.poorSleep: Slept much less than usual on each of the last three nights.
reasons.lowMood: Rated mood low at each of the last three Check-ins.
reasons.drift: Several Signals have stayed below their usual range for three days.
